name: vidiq
description: Connect vidIQ to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use vidIQ MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect vidIQ to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with youTube research and analytics using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my vidIQ workspace.
Find anything in vidIQ that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review youTube research and analytics in vidIQ.
